name: Stacked Can Pyramid — Jade
summary: Jade blank-label colour variant of the original P1 stacked can pyramid.
description: Six neat square tiers of 91 smooth-shaded eight-sided cans on a chamfered warm metal plinth. Coral variant_a and jade variant_b have blank colour bands, metallic seams and flat lids, with no text, logos, textures or external assets. Each GLB has one merged display mesh, two materials and a separate hidden collider scene.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python; no external models, images, fonts, textures or brands.
accuracy_notes: Static original P1 supermarket display for S07, S09, S10 and S11. Source retains 91 linked cans; each GLB merges cans and plinth into one two-primitive mesh. Collider is an opt-in conservative box covering the full prop, without material. Label variants are separately registered in the existing collection. Physical stacking stability, full mall placement and physical devices are unverified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and shared materials. No external assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

quality_gate.visual_review: PASS: both variants, front and three-quarter contact sheets at 1440 and 390 px

specification: Owner P1 override, GJH Virtual Mall v11 - P1 Model Task Sheet, 2026-11-17
